title: Control record
description: One YAML file per control. This repo is the system of record. Scytale, the trust center, and every framework baseline are projections of this.

control_id.description: ctl.<domain>.<layer>.<control>. Stable forever. Never reused. Rename = new id + supersedes edge.

owner.description: A team, never a person. Person-owned controls die when the person leaves.

function.description: FAIR-CAM control function. LEC = loss event control, VM = variance management, DS = decision support.

population_definition.description: Prose denominator an auditor reads. Must agree with query_ref. Drift between the two is a finding and tests/population-drift.test.mjs enforces it.

query_ref.description: Path to the dbt model. The model IS the evidence.

variance_started_at_quality.description: equals-detected systematically understates Variance Duration. Reliability derived from it is an UPPER BOUND and must be labelled as such.

crosswalk.description: Identifiers only. Never framework text. See ADR-0003 (SCF is CC BY-ND with an explicit AI-derivatives prohibition).

crosswalk_direct.description: Hand-maintained mappings where SCF is thin. Kept separate so inherited and hand-made mappings are never confused.

scenarios.description: Join to risk. A control with no scenario is unpriced — find its scenario or ask why it exists.

policy_ref.description: Null until status == operating. Policy is generated from the control, never authored ahead of it.

cost.description: Populate it or ROSI has nothing to divide by.

applicability_note.description: When a crosswalked obligation's applicability DATE is contested, deferred, or otherwise not simply 'in force', record it here with the instrument that changed it. A crosswalk says which clause a control serves; it does not say whether that clause bites yet, and conflating the two is how a compliance calendar goes wrong.
